interpretation: Applied analytical contract-design framework; no causal or behavioral UEFA estimates.
reference_mean_role: Public ex-post inventory used only as a dimensional reference scale; not an ex-ante forecast.
slope_cap_role: Scenario design restriction applied commonly across contracts; not a legal cap.
source_anchor_status: verified from data/headline_metrics.csv; exact equality checked
uncertainty_status: All noise amplitudes and distributions are assumption-led sensitivity scenarios, not estimates or confidence intervals.
randomness: None; deterministic integration, root finding and linear programming.
zero_noise_equal_floor_convention: Select constant payment B and slope zero; a kinked alternative has no two-sided local derivative at the reference point.
boundary_grid_note: F/B=1 is a diagnostic endpoint added to the prespecified interior sensitivity grid, not a fitted or selected result.
zero_noise_feasibility_note: At zero noise a positive two-sided marginal target requires H<B; the frontier value B is an unattained supremum.
